![Premium Adjustable Microneedle Derma Stamp for Skin](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/10090949-1509-0139-0000-dc8e437362d3:4)
A [Derma Stamp](https://drpen.net/blogs/blog/how-to-use-a-dermastamp-the-complete-derma-stamp-guide) is `a handheld microneedling tool with tiny needles that press vertically into the skin or scalp to create controlled micro-injuries`.[[1]](https://drpen.net/blogs/blog/how-to-use-a-dermastamp-the-complete-derma-stamp-guide)

### What It Does

- **Stimulates Collagen:** Punctures signal the body to boost collagen and elastin production.[[1]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:6925625265748466116,catalogid:5049052922177810266,gpcid:13321111991588250006,mid:576462914970981833&ibp=oshop)
- **Improves Absorption:** Creates micro-channels that help topical products like minoxidil, peptides, or serums sink deeper into the skin.[[1]](https://rhutehair.com/blogs/rhute-answers/derma-stamp-vs-roller-which-microneedling-tool-is-best-for-hair-growth)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ky3B-Fr6sss)
- **Promotes Hair Growth:** Wakens sluggish hair follicles and increases local blood flow.[[1]](https://rhutehair.com/blogs/rhute-answers/derma-stamp-vs-roller-which-microneedling-tool-is-best-for-hair-growth)

### Derma Stamp vs. Derma Roller

- **Vertical Motion:** Stamps enter and exit the skin at a clean 90-degree angle, preventing the dragging or tearing that can happen with rolling wheels.[[1]](https://rhutehair.com/blogs/rhute-answers/derma-stamp-vs-roller-which-microneedling-tool-is-best-for-hair-growth)[[2]](https://drpen.net/blogs/blog/how-to-use-a-dermastamp-the-complete-derma-stamp-guide)
- **Precision:** Easier to use on smaller, curved, or hair-covered areas like the hairline, crown, beard, or around the nose.[[1]](https://www.dr-pen.co.uk/product-category/derma-stamp/)[[2]](https://rhutehair.com/blogs/rhute-answers/derma-stamp-vs-roller-which-microneedling-tool-is-best-for-hair-growth)

### General Usage Guidelines

- **Sanitize:** Disinfect the needles in 75% to 100% isopropyl alcohol before and after each use.[[1]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DDonxTZSVON/?hl=en)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:2920830317343956027&ibp=oshop)
- **Clean Skin:** Wash and dry the treatment area thoroughly.[[1]](https://uk.drpen.co/products/derma-stamp-micro-needling-skin-tool)[[2]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DYg_daXxQFp/?hl=en)
- **Depth Selection:** 
	- *0.25 mm – 0.5 mm:* Best for daily product absorption or beginner scalp use (typically done once a week).
	- *1.0 mm – 1.5 mm+:* Deeper settings for facial scars or targeted treatments (use with caution).[[1]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DDonxTZSVON/?hl=en)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:2920830317343956027&ibp=oshop)
- **Technique:** Press the stamp straight down, lift, and move to the next spot without dragging across the skin.[[1]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DYg_daXxQFp/?hl=en)[[2]](https://rhutehair.com/blogs/rhute-answers/derma-stamp-vs-roller-which-microneedling-tool-is-best-for-hair-growth)
- **Hygiene:** Never share your tool with anyone else.[[1]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:2920830317343956027&ibp=oshop)

Are you planning to use the derma stamp for **facial skin/scars** or for **hair/beard growth** ? I can share a more tailored routine.
